items.title: Windows 10 OOB update released to fix Message Queuing (MSMQ) issues
items.description: This month's extended security update for Windows 11 broke Message Queuing (MSMQ), which is typically used by enterprises to manage background tasks. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28624: LiteLLM
items.description: A CVSS score 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Alfredo Oliveira and David Fiser of Trend Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-12-18, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-04-17 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
